definitions.explanation: The period of life from age 10 to 19. Used to refer to teenage years in general or to someone who is a teenager.

examples.japanese: {十代|じゅうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{思|おも}い{出|だ}す→思い出す：01258_omoidasu⟧。
{十代|じゅうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧だ。
examples.english: It's a brand popular with teenagers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十代|じゅうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{活躍|かつやく}している→活躍する：25354_katsuyakusuru⟧。
examples.english: She has been active as a professional since her late teens.

notes:
{十代|じゅうだい} refers to the teenage years (ages 10-19). Part of the 〜⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ pattern used for all age decades.

AGE DECADE PATTERN:
- {十代|じゅうだい}: teens (10-19)
- ⟦{二十代|にじゅうだい}→二十代：20477_nijuudai⟧: twenties (20-29)
- ⟦{三十代|さんじゅうだい}→三十代：16596_sanjuudai⟧: thirties (30-39)
- And so on for each decade

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十代|じゅうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧: teenagers
- {十代|じゅうだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}: during one's teens
- {十代|じゅうだい}⟦{前半|ぜんはん}→前半：11875_zenhan⟧: early teens (10-14)
- {十代|じゅうだい}⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧: late teens (15-19)

USAGE:
Unlike the English word "teenager" (13-19), {十代|じゅうだい} technically includes 10-12 year olds as well. In practice, context usually makes the intended range clear.
